# Review

## Outcome

**Approved**

## Evidence

- All 185 tank_core tests pass with 0 failures. cargo clippy -D warnings and cargo fmt --check both pass clean.
- route_consumed_food (shrimp.rs:185-258) correctly partitions consumed N+C through all five named pathways: feces→fine_detritus_g_total, excreted N→TAN, excreted C→DOC, respired C→DIC+O2 demand (scaled by available DO), retained→reserve_g. All controlled by 5 named parameters defined in default.toml.
- Alkalinity coupling implemented at lines 214 and 248: both excretion and respiration TAN production credit alkalinity_meq_total via excreted_n_mg/MG_N_PER_MEQ_AMMONIA and respired_n_mg/MG_N_PER_MEQ_AMMONIA respectively.
- v3→v4 migration (save.rs:331-343) seeds reserve_g from existing shrimp biomass (adults+juveniles) * LIVE_BIOMASS_ORGANIC_FRACTION_G_PER_G instead of defaulting to 0.0. Regression test legacy_schema_v3_saves_seed_reserve_from_existing_shrimp_biomass passes.
- O2-limited respiration (shrimp.rs:220-240) scales DIC/TAN by respiration_scale = actual_o2_consumed/o2_demand, retaining unrespired share in reserve_g. Covered by oxygen_limited_respiration_scales_dissolved_fluxes_and_retains_shortfall test.
- step_daily_shrimp (shrimp.rs:65-91) calls shrimp_feeding→refresh_carbonate_state→update_condition in correct order, ensuring condition uses post-feeding pH.
- fund_live_shrimp_biomass (shrimp.rs:641-653) returns false when reserve is insufficient with no dissolved-pool fallback.
- RemoveShrimp (engine.rs:402-414) computes reserve export against total population (adults_count + juveniles_count), not adults alone.
- Conservation tests all pass: closed_system_shrimp_feeding_conserves_nitrogen, closed_system_shrimp_feeding_conserves_carbon, test_closed_system_n_conservation, test_closed_system_c_conservation, test_closed_system_shrimp_mortality_conserves_n_and_c, test_closed_system_shrimp_reproduction_conserves_n_and_c.
- assimilated_plus_fecal_equals_consumed test verifies mass partition accuracy. feeding_generates_tan_and_dic_and_feces verifies diagnostic outputs.
- Process parameters (default.toml lines 89-94): shrimp_assimilation_efficiency=0.50, respiration_fraction=0.70, excretion_fraction=0.10, growth_fraction=0.20, o2_per_mg_c_respired=2.67.
- Consumer routing contract documented in docs/ROUTING.md. Phase-1 simplifications documented in code at shrimp.rs:155-158 (shared food quality) and shrimp.rs:250-253 (unbounded reserve accumulation).

## Findings and Gaps

- All four acceptance criteria are met: (1) consumed mass is partitioned into assimilated+fecal within tolerance, (2) TAN/DIC/O2/detritus are generated proportional to feeding and visible in diagnostics, (3) named parameters control all fractions with simplifications documented, (4) closed-system conservation tests confirm N and C are preserved.
- Both final-review amendments from round 4 have been implemented and tested: v3→v4 migration seeds reserve from population biomass; alkalinity is credited on TAN production from both excretion and respiration.
- No regressions detected. The previously failing substrate_filter_integration test is no longer failing.
- Phase-1 reserve accumulation limitation is explicitly documented in code comments as planned for later reserve/condition work.

## Follow-up and Amendments

None.
